steps.name: Threads sit above tasks on Home
steps.goal: Look at the Home screen list. Do not open anything.
steps.done: A Threads section with the Pricing ideas thread is at the top of the list, and a Tasks section follows it.

steps.name: A thread is a chat between people
steps.goal: Tap the row named Pricing ideas under the Threads heading. Do not tap the message field.
steps.done: The thread is open at its newest messages: Alex's message about the signup email and omg's reply.
expect: @omg also fix the typo in the signup email
Fixed "recieve" in the signup email. Tests pass.

steps.name: Task cards show their state
steps.goal: Read the task cards near the end of the thread. Do not tap a card.
steps.done: One task card says it needs you and one says it is done.
expect: Cap the free tier on the pricing page

steps.name: The task's question is answered in the thread
steps.goal: Read the question at the end of the thread. Do not tap an answer.
steps.done: The task's question and its two one-tap answers are visible.

steps.name: omg answered a quick question earlier
steps.goal: Scroll up in the thread to read the earlier messages. Do not tap anything.
steps.done: omg's short answer about Linear and Vercel pricing is visible.
expect: Linear starts at $8 per seat a month.

steps.name: Start a new thread
steps.goal: Leave the thread with the back button at the top left, then on Home tap the New thread button next to the Threads heading. Do not tap the message field or the add button.
steps.done: An empty new thread is open with its heading and starter prompts.
